verdict.rationale: Rippling has public APIs, developer docs and a CLI, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the pack documents API tokens, OAuth scopes, or least-privilege credentials for programmatic or agent access. The role-based permissions and Supergroup app-access rules govern employee access to Rippling and third-party apps, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit toward this story.
